t: Turn back before it is taken out of your hands
a: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
p: Wa anībū ilā rabbikum wa aslimū lahu min qabli an ya'tiyakumu-l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūn.
m: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
